Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a 29-year-old rapper, entertainer, and social media personality from Los Angeles, California. He first exploded onto the music scene in 2018 with his viral track “Respect My Cryppin’” before reaching mainstream success with his breakout hit “Thotiana,” which featured remixes with Cardi B and YG. Known for his unconventional offbeat rap flow, outspoken personality, and unpredictable antics, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop. Over the years, he has expanded beyond music into boxing, reality television, and livestreaming, consistently attracting attention through his viral moments and controversial relationships. His highly publicized on-and-off relationship with Chrisean Rock has remained one of the biggest talking points surrounding his personal life. 

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a 26-year-old rapper, reality television star, and social media personality from Baltimore, Maryland. She first gained recognition through Blueface’s reality series Blue Girls Club before becoming a breakout personality on the Zeus Network’s hit show Baddies. Her outspoken personality, emotional moments, and highly publicized relationship with Blueface helped turn her into one of the most talked-about personalities in reality television. She also built a music career with songs such as “Vibe” and “Lonely.” Chrisean and Blueface went on to star in their own reality series, Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love, documenting their complicated relationship. The two share a son, Chrisean Jr., and their repeated breakups and reconciliations have continued generating widespread attention across social media.
